items.q: What should you remember about **Monitor like a new car**?
items.a: **baseline hormone panels at puberty;** ~6-month follow-ups; testosterone + SHBG or free T, not T alone.

items.q: What should you remember about **Development never ends**?
items.a: **IGF-1/GH matter through ~25 for** bone stockpiling; fiber/microbiome set-point critical in teens–30s for lifelong brain/gut health.

items.q: What should you remember about **Vegan/carnivore extremes in early 20s/teens**?
items.a: **likely ↓ free androgens;** late 20s extremes more tolerable.

items.q: What should you remember about **Caloric deficit is context-dependent**?
items.a: **overweight → T benefit** long-term; lean → SHBG rises, free androgens fall, catabolic bias.

items.q: What should you remember about **TRT in 20s with normal labs**?
items.a: **"almost hardly never"; fertility, acne,** hair loss, mania, lipids, ferritin, microvascular risk — needs interdisciplinary physician team.

items.q: What should you remember about **Physiologic dose ≠ augmentation dose**?
items.a: **~120 mg/week divided; 200** mg/week often supra-physiologic; steady-state ≠ morning pulsatile physiology.

items.q: What should you remember about **Creatine for hormones**?
items.a: **slight total T ↑ and T→DHT** shunt; does not accelerate hair loss beyond being male; poor reason to avoid.

items.q: What should you remember about **L-carnitine = mitochondrial shuttle + AR density**?
items.a: **oral 1–5 g; IM injectable needs** Rx; TMAO risk at high dose → garlic allicin, berberine, or microbiome optimization.

items.q: What should you remember about **Tongkat ali**?
items.a: **steroidogenesis cascade upregulator; 300–1200 mg;** standardize eurycomanone; helps even normal SHBG via total/free T ↑.

items.q: What should you remember about **Fadogia agrestis**?
items.a: **LH release → Leydig testosterone; 300** mg/day human-safe rat equivalent; check GGT/alk phos; antioxidants attenuate rat toxicity signals.

items.q: What should you remember about **Low-dose tadalafil underrated**?
items.a: **prostate, nocturia, sleep, androgen** receptors; stay ≤10 mg/day (red-green cone effects at 20 mg).
**aromatase + GABAergic pituitary** suppression; 7 kcal/g; limit frequency not just volume.
